verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Replicate can deploy custom models with Cog and scales automatically, including down to zero. Nothing documents dedicated GPU capacity or isolation from a shared serverless pool. The only hint is a pricing line noting that 'other private models' bill for idle time, which implies but does not document reserved hardware. Generic autoscaling is an adjacent feature, not the dedicated, isolated deployment this story asks for.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can deploy a model on dedicated GPU capacity with autoscaling so my traffic is isolated from the shared serverless pool
